title: fix(codex): preserve conversations while native threads close
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where a managed Codex conversation fails while refreshing its configuration because native teardown is still in progress. Treating that rejection as an unavailable thread can also rotate a valid conversation instead of preserving its history.

Observed failure: [native settled-turn finalizer, preserveNativeModel-only host profile](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38945363873/job/117124255160): `thread/resume` returned `-32600`, reporting that the thread was still closing.

## Why This Change Was Made

Managed asynchronous teardown now waits for the exact thread's `thread/closed` notification. The earlier `notLoaded` status does not establish completed teardown. Initially unloaded threads retain their fast path; external native synchronous reloads retain their existing `notLoaded` contract.

The lifecycle owner permits one identical resume replay after the exact native pre-admission closing rejection, within the existing two-second close budget and the same signal, authority, and reservation. A second closing rejection preserves the binding, history, and siblings. Other RPC errors and ambiguous dispatched outcomes keep their existing cleanup behavior; compaction receives safe closing-error classification without a new replay flow.

Personally inspected Codex 0.162.0 at `c1382380de69521303b416720a52f42d51af6248`:

- [Pending-unload resume rejection](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/c1382380de69521303b416720a52f42d51af6248/codex-rs/app-server/src/request_processors/thread_processor.rs#L3650-L3659), repeated after resolving history at lines 3763–3773.
- [Asynchronous close publication before clearing the pending guard](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/c1382380de69521303b416720a52f42d51af6248/codex-rs/app-server/src/request_processors/thread_lifecycle.rs#L475-L484), and pre-subscription rejection at lines 714–726. The close notification alone is not claimed to be a race-free readiness acknowledgment.
- [Synchronous idle override reload](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/c1382380de69521303b416720a52f42d51af6248/codex-rs/app-server/src/request_processors/thread_processor.rs#L4351-L4380) calls `finalize_thread_teardown` at lines 1007–1017, which emits `notLoaded` without `thread/closed`.

## User Impact

Managed Codex conversations can refresh configuration while preserving existing history and unrelated work. If teardown remains incomplete, the original actionable closing error is retained. No configuration, dependency, protocol, persistence, or timeout changes.

Production: +104/−28 lines (net +76), justified by the native close/admission contract and ownership-preserving error handling. Tests/support: +153/−24 lines (net +129).

## Evidence

- PASS: [required exact-head CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38950221709) at `d033eae19f9d9112aa31c76622b92d3ab1748da7`.
- PASS: [lifecycle regression shard](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38950221709/job/117140215790), 5 files / 245 tests, including all 14 managed close/admission cases, history/binding and sibling preservation, timeout/abort/authority loss, and external synchronous reload without `thread/closed`.
- PASS: [resume and native sibling shard](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38950221709/job/117140215803), 37 files / 590 tests, including all 13 resume-helper cases and native lifecycle, cleanup, and compaction siblings.
- PASS: original native settled-turn finalizer `preserveNativeModel-only host profile` at the exact head on macOS arm64: 1 passed / 8 skipped; selected case 7.570 seconds. Normal repository wrapper and artifact preparation were used, with the pinned real Codex executable and synthetic loopback provider. No live provider inference is claimed.
- Counterfactual: `57c902e0f9bdfce5c72c752c2b14cc5bfc7f2718` production with only the current policy-refresh support and resume-helper tests overlaid produced exactly 2 expected failures / 4 passing controls. The managed lifecycle resumed after `notLoaded` before close (actual count 1, expected 0). The exact closing error caused an extra RPC; the native JSON abbreviates its array, while the inspected cleanup owner identifies that RPC as `thread/unsubscribe`. The lifecycle assertion's early failure also triggered Vitest's unawaited-assertion diagnostic; it is not claimed as a second production failure.
- PASS: pinned `oxfmt` 0.72.0, `git diff --check`, targeted `oxlint` 1.87.0, independent source review and Auto Review. The test-only mapping correction preserves all 14 scenario values.
- [Exact-head ClawSweeper review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174540#issuecomment-6222574457): no actionable findings; Before merge: None. Its runtime-proof gap is covered above.

### Native reproduction limit and review follow-up

The original Linux CI native failure is linked above. The same native scenario passed on the frozen macOS baseline as well as this candidate, so this is not a same-platform native failing-before/passing-after reproduction. The deterministic production-owner tests establish the two failure mechanisms and pass in exact-head CI; the real native candidate run verifies compatibility. The optional rank-up request for native before/after failure is therefore only partially fulfilled, with this platform limit recorded rather than claiming an unobserved failure. No additional retry or weaker assertion was introduced.
